topics.name: Boot Profile Resolution
topics.purpose: Define deterministic resolution from profile definition through positive selection, pruning and dependency validation into an exact candidate runtime component closure.

semantics.result_rule: Resolved profile is a derived candidate set with provenance back to profile selectors and dependencies.
semantics.dependency_rule: Required dependencies must be present/compatible but are never silently enabled outside declared closure semantics.
semantics.conflict_rule: Unresolved conflict hard-fails boot profile resolution.
semantics.ordering_rule: Filesystem/list iteration order never decides semantic resolution.
semantics.determinism_rule: Equivalent canonical profile/dependency state yields semantically equivalent resolved set.
semantics.activation_rule: Successful resolution does not itself activate runtime; activation is a separate step.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed resolution leaves prior runtime state unchanged until explicit activation policy acts.

invariants.rule: Boot/runtime availability is derived only from explicit profile selection plus validated dependency closure; discovery, installation, dependency presence or historical activation never silently enables a component.

hard_gates.condition: failed resolution partially changes live runtime

references.purpose: Resolved profile is input to separate runtime activation.

prose.summary: Define deterministic resolution from profile definition through positive selection, pruning and dependency validation into an exact candidate runtime component closure.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against runtime activation, install dependency and instance configuration contracts.
